# spikes/s1a/scripts/Remove-Spike.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Deletes the spike resource group, purges the soft-deleted Foundry resource, deletes the MCP server's Entra app, and checks that nothing is left, including the policy exemption, which the spend ledger's resource check can't see.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-RunId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-Location` | string | no | `'eastus2'` |  |
| `-McpAppId` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Provider` | string | no | `'Foundry'` | Anthropic: also delete the fallback's agent identity and blueprint (found by name, through Graph PowerShell). |
